This script generates a phylogenetic tree from the SNP data that was build using RAxML (GTR+G model of evolution was used with Lewis’s ascertainment bias correction [GTR+G+ASC_LEWIS]).

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/3_SNP_based_phylogenetic_tree"
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(treeio)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggnewscale)
library(janitor)
library(phytools)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
```

# Project Overview
```{r knit, echo = F,eval=F,warning=F,include=F}
results_path = here::here("results")
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/3_SNP_based_phylogenetic_tree"
rmarkdown::render(input = here("scripts", str_c(subdir_name, ".Rmd")), output_dir = results_path)
```

## Load and Root Phylogenetic Tree
```{r environmental, echo= T}
# Import the Newick file and apply midpoint rooting
data = here::here("data")
tree_raw= read.newick(file = glue::glue('{data}/tree_data/asptu.raxml.tree'))
tree_midpoint <- midpoint.root(tree_raw)
```

## Data Import and Cleaning
```{r data import}
variant_info <- read.csv(glue::glue('{data}/2026_variant_info.csv')) %>% select(isolate,variant,cyp51a,cyp51a_insert,cyp51b)
info_df <- read.csv(glue::glue('{data}/2026_meta_info.csv')) %>% select(-1) %>% rename(isolate = strain)
wang_etal_MIC <- read.table(glue::glue('{data}/1.Wang_etal_MIC.txt'), header =T) %>% 
   mutate_at(c('ITC', 'VOR', 'POS'), ~ gsub('>', '', .)) %>% 
  mutate_at(c('ITC', 'VOR', 'POS'), ~ as.numeric(.)) %>% 
  select(Species, ID, ITC, VOR, POS) %>% 
  rename(isolate = ID, itc = ITC, pos = POS, vrc = VOR, species = Species) %>% 
  mutate(
    origin = 'Clinical', 
    location = 'California', 
    isolate = as.character(isolate),
    species = gsub('A.', 'aspergillus ', species)
  )
# Merge all datasets
total_dataset <- full_join(info_df, wang_etal_MIC) %>% 
  left_join(variant_info, by = 'isolate') %>% 
  mutate(species = gsub('aspergillus','Aspergillus',species)) %>% 
  mutate(species = case_when(location == 'California' ~ species, TRUE ~ 'This study')) 

rm(variant_info,info_df,wang_etal_MIC)  
write.csv(x = total_dataset, file = glue::glue('{data}/2026_MIC_combined.csv'))


```

## MIC Normalization (ECOFF Distances)
```{r ECOFF}
# Define Epidemiological Cutoff Values (ECOFF)
ecoffs <- data.frame(
  antifungal = c('flu', 'itc', 'pos', 'vrc', 'teb', 'pro', 'dif', 'pth'),
  ecoff      = c(NA, 2, 0.5, 4, 16, 8, 16, 4),
  log2ecoff  = log2(c(NA, 2, 0.5, 2, 16, 8, 16, 4))
)

# Calculate log2 distance from ECOFF
fd <- total_dataset %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(itc, pos, vrc, teb, pro, dif, pth), names_to = 'antifungal', values_to = 'value') %>% 
  mutate(value = round(log2(value), digits = 0)) %>% 
  left_join(ecoffs, by = 'antifungal') %>% 
  mutate(ecoff_adj_log2 = value - log2ecoff) %>% 
  filter(antifungal != 'flu') %>% 
  select(isolate, antifungal, ecoff_adj_log2)

# Create matrix for gheatmap
fd_long <- fd %>% pivot_wider(names_from = 'antifungal', values_from = 'ecoff_adj_log2')
ECOFF_heatmap    <- as.matrix(fd_long[2:8])
rownames(ECOFF_heatmap) <- fd_long$isolate

rm(fd,fd_long)
```

## Phylogenetic Visualization
```{R phylo_tree}
# Prepare Source/Origin data
origins  <- select(total_dataset, isolate, origin, location) %>% distinct()
row.names(origins) <- origins$isolate
source      <- origins %>% select(-c(isolate, location))

# Base tree plot (Fan layout)
open_angle <- 30
quick_tree <- ggtree(tree_midpoint, layout = 'fan', open.angle = open_angle) + 
  geom_tiplab(size = 1, align = FALSE, offset = max(tree_midpoint$edge.length) / 20)

# get number of branches to adjust scale on the branchsize
branches <- length(unique(quick_tree$data$label)) - 1

# Attach species data to tree
tree_data <- quick_tree %<+% total_dataset + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = species)) + 
  scale_color_discrete(name = 'Species')

Log2MICs = sort(unique(as.vector(ECOFF_heatmap)))
res_MICs  = length(which(Log2MICs > 0)) # Counts number of values above ECOFF in total
sens_MICs = length(Log2MICs)- res_MICs # Counts number of values above ECOFF in total
blues = hcl.colors(sens_MICs+3, "Blues 3")[1:sens_MICs]
reds  = rev(hcl.colors(res_MICs+3, "Reds 3")[1:res_MICs])
# Heatmap 1: MIC Distances
heatmap_ecoff <- gheatmap(
    tree_data, 
    as.matrix(ECOFF_heatmap), 
    color          = 'white',
    colnames_angle = -90,
    hjust          = 0,
    width          = 0.05 * ncol(ECOFF_heatmap),
    offset         = max(quick_tree$data$x) / 5,
    colnames       = TRUE,
    font.size      = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c(blues,reds),
    name     = expression(atop(Log[2]~"(MIC) distance", "from ECOFF", "   ")),
    breaks = c(-8,-4,-2,0,1,2,4),
    labels = c('-8','-4','-2','0 (WT)','1 (NWT)','2','4'),
   # guide = 'legend'
  )

#reset scaling for colors
tmp    <- heatmap_ecoff + new_scale_fill()


# Heatmap 2: Origin/Source
heatmap_ecoff_source <- gheatmap(
    tmp, 
    source, 
    colnames_angle = -90, 
    hjust          = 0,
    font.size      = 1.5,
    width          = 0.05,
    offset         = max(quick_tree$data$x) * 0.6
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(name = 'Source', values = c('#8fcae7', '#777b00')) + 
  geom_treescale(
    x      = max(quick_tree$data$x) / 6, 
    y      = branches + 5,
    width  = 0.3, 
    color  = "black", 
    offset = 1
  )

heatmap_ecoff_source_cyp51 = heatmap_ecoff_source + geom_tiplab(
    aes(label = variant),     
    offset = max(quick_tree$data$x) * 0.7,            
    size = 2, 
    hjust = -0.1,align = T,linesize = 0
  )



```
## View Plot
```{r visualize}
heatmap_ecoff_source_cyp51
```

## Save Plot
```{r}
dir_path = here::here("plots")
ggsave(plot = heatmap_ecoff_source_cyp51, glue::glue('{dir_path}/Fig_3_tree.svg'), height = 8, width = 10)

```


## adding Clonal groups to the plot
```{r}
results_path = here::here("results")
CG = read.csv(glue::glue('{results_path}/clonal_groups.csv')) %>% filter(strains_count > 4) %>% 
  select(group_id,strain) %>% rename("clonal group" = group_id)


row.names(CG) <- CG$strain
CG     <-CG %>% select(-c(strain))

tmp     <- heatmap_ecoff_source_cyp51 + new_scale_fill()

heatmap_ecoff_source_cyp51_clonal_groups <- 
  gheatmap(
    tmp, 
    CG, 
    colnames_angle = -90, 
    hjust          = 0,
    font.size      = 1.5,
    width          = 0.05,
    offset         = max(quick_tree$data$x) * 0.8)+
    scale_fill_manual(name = 'Clonal group (>4)', values  = viridis::plasma(7), na.value = 'white') 

heatmap_ecoff_source_cyp51_clonal_groups


 


```
